description: Fixed-timeout FIFO expiration queue replaces full pending-map scans. Normal optimized release build, queue diagnostics off. Three repetitions/load at1900/2000offeredTPS; five-second offered windows; four validator processes plus oneclient on shared8-logical-CPU macOS host. Real signatures and durablegroup64requests/1ms,20msonewaydelay,5sdeadline,maxinflight16384. All signature/quorum/state/journal and before/after-verification deadline checks unchanged. No deliberate concurrent builds/tests/profiling during measurements. Throughput includes drain. Short-run measurements, not sustained capacity guarantees.

report.measurement_definition: Signed transaction submission before transport enqueue to client receipt and strict Ed25519 verification of effects QC; client generation/signing excluded; network queues, fixed per-direction delay, validator validation/signing and group sync_all before votes included.
report.limits: One host, loopback TCP, fixed one-way delay without packet-loss/bandwidth modelling; one hot collective pool; bounded journal group commit; filesystem/device sync_all guarantees assumed. Finalized latency percentiles are conditional; all-submitted quantiles include right-censored stalls.
